items.source: The default implementation delegates to the CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate that was supplied when this TestContext was constructed.
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给在构造此TestContext时提供的CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate。

items.source: Note: this is a mutable property.
items.translation: 注意：这是一个可变属性。

items.source: Determine if the application context for this test context is present in the context cache.
items.translation: 确定此测试上下文的应用上下文是否存在于上下文缓存中。

items.source: Since JUnit Jupiter 5.12, if the SpringExtension is used with a test-method scoped ExtensionContext, the Class returned from this method may refer to the test class for the current test method, which may be a @Nested test class within the class for the test instance. Thus, if you need consistent access to the class for the current test instance within an implementation of TestExecutionListener.prepareTestInstance(TestContext), you should invoke testContext.getTestInstance().getClass() instead of testContext.getTestClass().
items.translation: 自 JUnit Jupiter 5.12 起，如果与 `test-method` 范围的ExtensionContext一起使用SpringExtension，此方法返回的`Class`可能引用当前测试方法的测试类，该测试类可能是@Nested测试类，位于测试实例的类内部。因此，如果您需要在TestExecutionListener.prepareTestInstance(TestContext)的实现中一致地访问当前测试实例的类，您应该调用`testContext.getTestInstance().getClass()`而不是`testContext.getTestClass()`。

items.source: Concrete implementations should track the supplied MethodInvoker and return it from TestContext.getMethodInvoker(). Note that the standard TestContext implementation in Spring overrides this method appropriately.
items.translation: 具体实现应跟踪提供的 `MethodInvoker`，并从TestContext.getMethodInvoker()返回它。请注意，Spring 中的标准`TestContext`实现已适当覆盖此方法。

items.source: Concrete implementations should return the MethodInvoker supplied to TestContext.setMethodInvoker(MethodInvoker). Note that the standard TestContext implementation in Spring overrides this method appropriately.
items.translation: 具体实现应返回提供给 TestContext.setMethodInvoker(MethodInvoker) 的 MethodInvoker。请注意，Spring 中的标准 TestContext 实现会适当重写此方法。

items.source: If value is null, the attribute is removed.
items.translation: 如果 `value` 为 `null`，则属性被移除。

items.source: WARNING: This method should only be invoked by the TestContextManager.
items.translation: 警告：此方法仅应由 TestContextManager 调用。

items.source: Immutable state includes all arguments supplied to the standard constructor.
items.translation: 不可变状态 包括传递给 标准构造函数 的所有参数。

items.source: By default, this method returns MethodInvoker.DEFAULT_INVOKER.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此方法返回MethodInvoker.DEFAULT_INVOKER。

items.source: Compute a new value for the attribute identified by name if necessary and set the new value in this AttributeAccessor.
items.translation: 如有必要，计算由 `` 标识的属性的新值，并在该`AttributeAccessor`中通过set设置新值。

items.source: Mark the application context associated with this test context as unused so that it can be safely paused if no other test classes are actively using the same application context.
items.translation: 将与此测试上下文关联的application context标记为未使用，以便在没有其他测试类正在使用该 application context 时，可以安全地暂停它。

items.source:
Caution: concurrent invocations of this method might not be thread-safe,
depending on the underlying implementation.
items.translation: 注意： 此方法的并发调用可能不是线程安全的，具体取决于底层实现。

items.translation: 默认情况下，此方法不执行任何操作。

items.source:
In general, users should take care to prevent overlaps with other
metadata attributes by using fully-qualified names, perhaps using
class or package names as prefix.
items.translation: 通常，用户应通过使用完全限定名称（例如使用类名或包名作为前缀）来防止与其他元数据属性发生重叠。

items.source:
The default implementation of this method is not thread safe but can
be overridden by concrete implementations of this interface.
items.translation: 此方法的默认实现不是线程安全的，但可以被该接口的具体实现类重写。
